instructions.title: How to download TikTok video without watermark
instructions.intro: Our TikTok downloader lets you save videos without the app's watermark. Follow the steps below to download TikTok videos in high quality, for free, with no software to install.
instructions.step1: Copy the video link on TikTok — Open the video in the TikTok app or website and tap "Share" to copy the link.
instructions.step2: Paste the link in the box above — In the text field on this page, paste the link you copied (Ctrl+V or long-press and paste).
instructions.step3: Click Download — The system will fetch the video and prepare the version without watermark.
instructions.step4: Save the video without watermark — When the video appears, click "Save video" to download it to your device.
